about: Progress on the five v1 done-conditions (proposals/hive-brain-v1/ROADMAP.md, Outcome). Updated by hand at each stop, each line with its evidence. status: done | partway | not_started. decisions_in_terminal: decisions the terminal session is holding for Brian (shown on the dashboard's Decisions screen).

conditions.name: Pilot
conditions.plain: Three real tasks from at least two projects go from your weekly plan to a merged pull request without hand-holding; you are asked first only for public-facing or irreversible changes (your rule, 2026-10-03).
conditions.evidence: Task 1 (AES quickstart fix) merged 2026-10-03 as AES PR #88 after your review. Pilot 2 (personal-wiki, confidence-label currency) is scoped as BRI-20; the Coordinator creates its task from 21:35 UTC on 2026-10-03 (one pilot per 6 hours).
conditions.next: Task 2 (a stale-page checker for your private people wiki, started 21:41 UTC on 2026-10-03) merges itself when its check passes; then task 3 from about 03:40 UTC.

conditions.name: Capabilities
conditions.plain: All 11 capabilities have a chosen off-the-shelf tool that is running and was used by the pilot tasks.
conditions.progress: 11 running; 7 used by a pilot task
conditions.evidence: Pilot task 1 used orchestration, messaging, the terminal relay, governance, the project brain, runtime and learning. Not yet shown in pilot use: knowledge, context freshness, evaluation. Model routing became capability 11 on 2026-10-03: the Coordinator plans on Sonnet 5, the builder codes on Opus 5.
conditions.next: Pilot tasks 2 and 3, then the weekly readout over all three.

conditions.name: Learning loop
conditions.plain: A recurring failure becomes a rule you accept; the rule is enforced, its log shows it firing, and a wrong block comes back as an issue.
conditions.evidence: Rule K1 (never delete the folder a session stands in) came from a failure that happened twice, you accepted it, and it is enforced; a live test was blocked and logged.
conditions.next: A block during real work, and one wrong block reported back as an issue.

conditions.name: Nothing silent
conditions.plain: Every control logs what it did, and none went quiet for a week.
conditions.evidence: The silence check runs daily and records each result; first all-clean day 2026-10-03 (11 of 11 controls at 17:50 UTC, now including four project brains).

conditions.name: Pick-up
conditions.plain: A fresh agent can resume from the plan alone.
conditions.evidence: A fresh agent given only the plan got the state right but lacked commands and ids; those were added (AES #82).
conditions.next: Re-test with a fresh agent after more pilot tasks.

decisions_in_terminal.question: May I report a bug to the Jev gate's maintainer?
decisions_in_terminal.context: One of Jev's built-in rules wrongly blocks commands that only mention `env … | curl` (4 of its 8 wrong blocks in our log). Our settings can't loosen a built-in rule. A tested fix keeps all 6 real leaks blocked and fires 1 time instead of 7 across 8,285 logged commands.
decisions_in_terminal.recommendation: Post the issue on eugeniughelbur/jev-engineering (public, under your GitHub account) and patch our copy meanwhile.
